acceptance: Either required-version is set and CI passes with it, or the decision not to enforce is recorded
context: Done in PR #3366: `required-version = ">=0.13.4"` under [tool.uv] in the root, _project/scripts and _project/sql-translation-ml pyproject.toml, plus a changelog entry. Proof: `uvx uv@0.12.1 lock --check` exits 2 with the required-version error; uv 0.13.5 `uv lock --check` passes in all three projects. CI uses astral-sh/setup-uv (v7.6.0, pinned by SHA, no `version:` input), which reads required-version and installs a compatible uv; the Dockerfiles already copy uv 0.13.5; no test pins [tool.uv].
description: `docs/development/development.md` asks contributors for uv 0.13.4 or newer, because older uv embeds root certificates that trust the compromised eMudhra emSign CAs (GHSA-hq85-5cpj-mr62). Nothing enforces it: `pyproject.toml` has no `[tool.uv] required-version`, and CI installs whatever `astral-sh/setup-uv` resolves. A contributor or container with an older uv keeps working silently. Decide whether to add `required-version = ">=0.13.4"` (uv refuses to run below it) and check that CI, the `benchbox-agent` image and the release workflows satisfy it.
